Not an atlas-era field lump: 1970-1984 surveyors knew only White-tailed Lark (Mirafra albicauda, 146 Kenyan eBird records 2009-2023) here. A disjunct resident population of Melodious Lark (Mirafra cheniana, 199 Kenyan eBird records 2009-2023) - previously known no closer than central Zimbabwe, ~2000 km south - was confirmed present in southern Kenya/northern Tanzania by mtDNA and song (Cohen et al. 2022, "Disjunct resident population of Melodious Lark Mirafra cheniana discovered in East Africa," J. Ornithol. 164:55-71, doi:10.1007/s10336-022-02013-z). Melodious Lark's occurrence here was unknown until then, so old-atlas records for this concept may be either species. avibase_id points to Avibase's "Mirafra sp." genus spuh (avibase-E32DAEE2): neither species has its own combined-concept page, so this is the closest single link for the pair.
